column1: # VierApparatus product import template. Rows that start with # are instructions and examples: they are ignored on import. Fill in your products under the header row (the row that starts with product_id).

# Required columns: name, manufacturer, category. Everything else is optional. Leave product_id empty to add a new product, or fill it with an existing Product ID (for example P-00012) to update that product.
# Lists (specifications, features, applications, ...) use | between items. Specifications are written Label: Value. Addresses must start with https://. Do not enter prices: this is not a shop.
# Write only what the manufacturer or a documented source states. Do not copy reviews or invent claims. Comments from readers are collected on the site, not here.

column20: draft, under_review, approved, published, archived or rejected

column2: The product name as the manufacturer names it.
column4: The product category. A name that does not exist yet creates the category.
column5: The manufacturer's model or catalogue number.
column6: A stock or catalogue code, if there is one.
column7: One or two sentences saying what the product is. Required to publish.
column9: Manufacturer-provided specifications. Separate items with | (or a new line inside the cell); write each as Label: Value.
column10: Key features claimed by the manufacturer. Separate items with |.
column11: Intended laboratory applications. Separate items with |.
column12: Editorial assessment: advantages. Leave empty unless an editor has assessed the product.
column13: Editorial assessment: limitations. Leave empty unless an editor has assessed the product.
column14: Certifications that are documented by the manufacturer or a certifying body.
column15: The main product image. Upload images in the product editor to have them converted to WebP and stored in the image bucket.
column16: The product page on the manufacturer's or supplier's site.
column19: How far the editorial review has gone. Empty means listed (manufacturer information only).
column20: Empty means draft. Publishing needs a name, manufacturer, category and short description.
column21: The page title for search engines. Empty: made from the name.
column22: The page description for search engines.
column23: Internal notes. Never shown to visitors.

column7: A sentence describing the product, taken from the manufacturer's documentation.
